description.value:
1 or r

With a moment's thought, you trigger the detonation of a mine you deployed within 150 feet, causing it to explode in a @Template[burst|distance:10]. A mine deals your choice of either @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+2)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage or @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+2)d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

You can Detonate Mine as a reaction, with the following trigger: Trigger A creature enters or leaves a square within 10 feet of a mine you've deployed. If your mine has a larger radius, increase this distance to that amount.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6. At 10th level, the burst radius increases to @Template[burst|distance:15]{15 feet}, and at 15th level, the burst radius increases to @Template[burst|distance:20]{20 feet}.
